caveats: Because the remap changes the output token inventory, this is a diagnostic control rather than a same-surface leaderboard result.
The absence of a single-label collapse after removing K suggests the locality evidence is usable, but the current label geometry still distorts how that evidence is mapped to outputs.
The next model-side step should test a neutral label inventory or head/objective redesign on the main packet rather than more packet-order changes.
decision: The Stage9894 remap control does not improve headline exact over the locality-lift baseline, but it removes the single-label K collapse. That is strong evidence that class-token geometry, not just packet semantics, still limits the current 100M edit-localization head.
